notes: Company background: mid-market B2B SaaS that embeds product docs and user conversations into search-driven experiences inside app.
Primary ask: reliable embeddings throughput for nightly batch jobs (~1M records) plus low-latency vector similarity for live queries (P95 < 120ms).
Current infra: ingest pipeline on GCP, uses Pinecone for vector storage; evaluating moving embedding generation to Redwood to reduce cost and increase throughput.
Quote from Head of Product: 'We need predictable cost for our nightly embed runs — spikes last quarter doubled infra costs.'

POC scope suggested by SE: 1) run sample 100k embed batch to validate throughput/cost; 2) simulate 250 req/s retrieval load for 1 hour; 3) validate prefix caching and KV cache improvements for chat-like queries.
Integration notes: prefer server-side batch API + S3-based ingestion, want sample connector + terraform example for Pinecone and self-managed Postgres metadata store.
SE concerns: memory footprint for 1M vector workflow, eviction/caching policy for live queries, fallback routing when Dedicated pool saturation occurs.
Finance question: need a clear mapping from tokens/embedding units to committed spend for forecasting (monthly burn estimate).
Security: stressed need for SSO (SAML) for 12 engineers + audit logs for model calls. KMS integration required for encryption-at-rest keys.
Competitive watch: they evaluated OpenAI for embeddings cost, but found variable latency at scale; Pinecone separate for similarity — want unified vendor to reduce ops overhead.
